name: Suzhou Highfine Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Highfine Biotech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chemicals for pharmaceutical research and development, and API production companies in China. The company's products include building blocks, protein reagents, protein crosslinkers, liposomes, ionic liquids, protective amino acids, unnatural amino acids, nucleotide reagents, etc. Its products are used in fields of peptide, nucleotide, and pharmaceutical synthesis. Suzhou Highfine Biotech Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Suzhou, China.
